steps.title: Mine copper ore
steps.hints: Find a copper ore node nearby. If none is in sight, explore or ask Zezima where the copper is. If gather says the pickaxe tier is too low, stop and report it, because I would then need a Bone Pickaxe first.

steps.title: Mine tin ore
steps.hints: Tin nodes are usually near the copper. Watch the bag weight, because each ore weighs about 2.4.

steps.title: Walk to the Furnace
steps.hints: The Furnace is station_1, about 8 m from the start.

steps.title: Smelt Bronze Bars
steps.hints: Run craft_plan on Bronze Bar first to check the ratio and fuel. If fuel is missing, gather logs. If I have fewer than 5 bars after smelting, gather more ore and repeat.

steps.title: Craft the Bronze Pickaxe
steps.hints: The recipe uses 5 Bronze Bar, 4 Oak Logs and 2 Leather.

events.description: Make a better pickaxe. The first target is a Bone Pickaxe (tier 2), because the Bronze route needs ore that a Stone Pickaxe can't mine.
events.explanation: The Bronze Pickaxe needs 5 Bronze Bars, and those need copper and tin ore. The wiki says that ore needs a bone pickaxe or better, so Bone comes first. Bone Pickaxe recipe (from craft_plan): 8 Animal Bone, 6 Ash Logs and 4 Leather, made at a Crafting Table. I have 2 Leather. The plan is to gather the missing materials, then craft at a Crafting Table. Bronze comes afterwards via ore, the Furnace and the Blacksmith's Bench, which are both nearby.

events.description: Gather copper and tin ore, smelt Bronze Bars at the Furnace, then craft the Bronze Pickaxe at the Blacksmith's Bench
events.explanation: The Bronze Pickaxe needs 5 Bronze Bars, 4 Oak Logs and 2 Leather, and I already have the logs and leather. The game data shows the bar recipe only in truncated form. The wiki says 3 copper and 3 tin make 2 bars, but that may be outdated. I'll gather 15 of each ore, smelt, and check with craft_plan how many bars I actually get. Copper nodes may need a bone pickaxe or better, so the first gather also tests whether my Stone Pickaxe can mine them.
